messages:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's cross-region error spike. TL;DR: repeated client retries + LB routing fallback to legacy SNI path caused backend thrash and higher tail latency. I uploaded notes and an initial action list below — please ack and update ETA if you take an item.

incident-bot: Postmortem uploaded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-20-network-regression (auto-tagged: network, lb, dns, tls) :paperclip:

liam: reading now. initial callout: the routing rule for region-preferring route-sets had a 200ms probe timeout; when probes flapped we fell back to the SNI path that hits the old pool. That pool has lower capacity so you get retry storms.

toni: I'll own the routing rule change — increase probe timeout and add a healthy-check backoff window. Plan: patch in staged cluster -> canary -> prod. ETA: 2026-03-26 EOD.

alex: thanks. can you add a preflight validation? I want a smoke test that verifies cross-region steering + SNI fallback doesn't reduce healthy capacity. Example smoke: curl to edge with region header and confirm 200s from preferred pool.

liam: sample smoke script posted in thread: 
```
# smoke.sh
for r in us-east eu-west ap-sg; do
  curl -H "X-Test-Region: $r" https://edge.redwood.ai/health || echo "fail $r"
done
```
Use the header to force routing.

devops-lead: I've scheduled a recurring regression triage: Wednesdays 11:00 UTC starting 2026-03-25. Add the routing/DNS/TLS owners to the invite. We'll review metrics for cross-region retries and any trendlines.

toni: acked. I'll post the patch PR tomorrow and link runbook steps. Also proposing a short-term mitigation: pin clients to ipv4 LB VIP for high-traffic flows while we roll. Thoughts?

maya: mitigation idea acknowledged, want engineering signoff on pinning risk. If we do pin, add a rollback flag and a monitoring alert to watch 5xx and retry_rate > 3% over 2m.

alex: +1 on alerts. I'll add SLO-derived alert thresholds to the runbook.

liam: action items summary (from thread):
- TONI: routing probe/backoff config change (owner) — ETA 2026-03-26 EOD
- LIAM: coordinate canary + smoke script, add test harness (owner) — ETA 2026-03-24 noon
- ALEX: add alert thresholds and preflight validation to runbook (owner) — ETA 2026-03-25
- MAYA: confirm mitigation approval process / communicate to oncall (owner) — ETA 2026-03-23 COB

maya: thanks everyone. Please update the PR/issue with timestamps and mark any follow-ups that should be tracked in the weekly triage. I'll close this thread when the production patch is live and stable for 24h. :white_check_mark:
